predictions.articleTitle: Decoupling Al-Fateh vs Al Riyadh: Expected Goals (xG), Finishing Waste & Match Analysis
predictions.coreRecommendation: Al-Fateh's 1.21 vs 0.87 xG-per-match edge and 38.7% Dixon-Coles win probability favor Home Win / Draw against an Al Riyadh side winless in six away matches.
possibilityAssessment: Primary Thesis: Home Win / Draw — Al-Fateh lead expected goals and midfield OTI while Al Riyadh sit 0W-3D-3L away, with the draw retained for finishing variance (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Secondary Angle: Over 2.5 Goals — Combined lambda of 2.75 and both defenses conceding over 2.05 goals per match point to three or more goals (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

Contingency Angle: 1:1 Score Draw — Highest single Poisson scoreline density (12.7%) if Al-Fateh's 78.9% big-chance miss rate persists against Al Riyadh's second-half transitions (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Al-Fateh xG edge meets Al Riyadh's winless away defensive fragility.

spf.comment: Covers a 2:1 Al-Fateh breakthrough driven by 1.21 xG/match and a 1:1 draw if finishing waste persists; a single Home Win is weaker given Al-Fateh's 0W-1D-5L home record.

over_under.comment: Backed by a 2.75 combined lambda, 51.9% Poisson Over 2.5 probability, and defensive concession rates of 2.08 and 2.27 goals per match.

btts.comment: Supported by 56.4% Poisson BTTS probability and identical 16.7% clean-sheet rates for Al-Fateh at home and Al Riyadh away.

score.comment: 2:1 captures Al-Fateh's midfield creation edge against leaky road defending, while 1:1 covers the top 12.7% Poisson stalemate.

goals.comment: 3 goals reflects the Over 2.5 and 2:1 primary script, with 2 goals covering the 24.8% modal Poisson bin and 1:1 contingency.

bqc.comment: Both sides reach half-time level around 50% of the time before Al-Fateh's xG edge either breaks through late or settles level.
